description: This file defines a ViewModel called NoteEditorViewModel used for editing notes in a note-taking app. It manages UI state, interacts with the NotesRepository for CRUD operations, and exposes functions for saving and deleting notes.

classes.name: NoteEditorUiState
classes.description: Data class representing the UI state for the note editor, holding an optional Note object.

classes.name: NoteEditorViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel class that manages the state and operations for editing a note, including saving and deleting notes through a repository.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a note with the given title and content, creating a new note if noteId is null, or updating an existing one. Executes onDone callback after completion.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the current note if noteId is not null and executes onDone callback after deletion.
